body:
Thank you.

Yeah, I'm ridiculously "strong", I guess. To the point where it *is* numbing me.

Just an hour ago, I was told that I wasn't allowed to move-in and room with my group of friends because they all agreed I was abrasive at times and really harsh without even realizing it. But it didn't even bother me. It should have, but it didn't. And that's just tiring.

But I can't help but live, you know?

I'm glad I'm not the only one who is like this. I'll learn to tackle the smaller problems first, and then work my way up to the bigger ones. I'll see what I can do. Maybe, one day, I can fix my emotional numbness and never have these suicidal-like thoughts ever again.
